findings: The nflverse injuries feed carried NO report_status for any of the 16 Sunday teams at mint time (163 Week-8 rows, all blank). Practice status alone is not a game designation and was not promoted, so the ESPN public summary endpoint supplied every designation used here.

The sealed epaDropoffTable keys are {QB1, QB_QUESTIONABLE, OL, SKILL, DEF}; the designation mapping emits {WR1, WR2, WR3, TE1, RB1, QB1, QB_QUESTIONABLE, LT, CB1, EDGE1}. Only the QB keys intersect, and no QB is designated in this slot, so OL/LT, CB1 and EDGE1 designations carry zero engine weight. This reconfirms the v2.5 finding on 8 games; the fix is a mapping change, which is model behavior and was not made on a game day.

Because Sinkhorn reallocates rather than deletes target-share mass, and the sealed multipliers apply to the small residual, the measured overlay effect is under 0.1 points on every game in the slot (max |delta| 0.097). The overlay is inert for this card, and the tickets are minted on the sealed calls unchanged.
Weather is reported as flags only. No points coefficient was applied, by doctrine.
